title: Harmonization
hook: The same argument comes up in every team meeting. It's costing more than you think.
statement: Smooth out friction between the parts of your business and life, and actually settle it.
explainer: Unresolved friction doesn't stay small. It eats time, mood, and momentum. Talking about a conflict isn't the same as closing it.
sop: List the recurring friction points between people, teams, or schedules.
Assign one owner to resolve each one.
Set a short weekly check-in just to catch friction early.
Fully settle one conflict this week. Count it only when both sides agree.
After 30 days, check how many Resolutions actually stuck.
equation_example: You fully settled 3 conflicts this month. That's a score of 3. Higher and rising means you're clearing friction faster than it shows up. Flat or zero means it's quietly piling up.
question: Name the one friction point you keep talking about but never actually settle.
closing_statement: Unresolved friction compounds quietly until it doesn't.
caption:
Principle Nº 202: Harmonization

The same argument comes up in every team meeting. It's costing more than you think.

Smooth out friction between the parts of your business and life, and actually settle it.

Your turn: Name the one friction point you keep talking about but never actually settle.
